honesty: No App Store app today · Innsegall does not scan your phone or tablet · the Mac runs the scout · this install is Companion on Home Screen plus a pinned panic guide.

companion_track.title: Install Companion (Battle Scout inbox)
companion_track.lead: Takes about two minutes · data stays on this device · not antivirus.

steps.title: Open Companion in Safari
steps.body: Type or tap innsegall.com/companion · use Safari (Chrome on iOS cannot Add to Home Screen the same way).

steps.title: Add to Home Screen
steps.body: Tap the Share button (square with up arrow) · scroll · Add to Home Screen · name it Innsegall · Add.

steps.title: Open from the icon
steps.body: Launch from your Home Screen · full-screen inbox · import paste from your Mac scout · tap Load sample to see how it looks.

steps.title: After a Mac scout
steps.body: On the Mac Battle Scout · tap Copy for AI · paste into Companion · or share the JSON to Files and use Files import.

steps.title: Bookmark this page
steps.body: Share → Add Bookmark · or Add to Home Screen on iPhone guide / iPad guide separately.

steps.title: Use the jump chips
steps.body: Bad link · email · download · fake popup · scroll to your scenario · follow steps on this device first.

settings_tour.title: Where to look in Settings (after a scare)

items.label: Safari · clear one site
items.path: Settings → Safari → Advanced → Website Data → search the site → Remove

items.label: Downloads
items.path: Files app → Downloads · delete without opening

items.label: Notifications spam
items.path: Settings → Notifications → Safari · turn off unwanted alerts

ios.hero: Put Innsegall on your iPhone · Companion inbox + panic guide · no App Store.
ios.add_to_home_note: On iPhone the Share button is at the bottom of Safari (or top on iPad in landscape).

tablet.hero: Put Innsegall on your iPad · Companion inbox + split-screen with chat · no App Store.
tablet.add_to_home_note: On iPad use Share (top right) → Add to Home Screen.
tablet.tablet_tip: Tip: open Companion in Safari side-by-side with Messages or ChatGPT · paste triage without leaving the thread.
